_comment: Project Browser for the emtk window, drawn by emtk.view_form over ProjectPanel (gui/panel.py): the toolbar, the search row, the project/version tree as a data_table with disclosure triangles, and the details tabs. The dialogs and the context menu are drawn by gui/app.py.

sections.description: Restore, save, export, import or delete a project version, reload the list, inspect a stored version, open the guide or the help.

buttons.label: Open / Restore
buttons.description: Restore the selected version, or the newest version of the selected project, replacing the current session. Greyed until a row is selected. Double-clicking a row does the same.

buttons.label: Save Current Project
buttons.description: Save all current datasets, fits and instrument state as a new database version of the current project, or as a new project.

buttons.label: Export .cs.pto
buttons.description: Export the selected exact version as a portable project archive. Greyed until a version row is selected.

buttons.label: Import Project
buttons.description: Preview a project archive, check its IDs and import it after confirmation.

buttons.label: Delete Version
buttons.description: Soft-delete the selected version after confirmation; database manage permission is required. Greyed until a version row is selected.

buttons.label: Refresh
buttons.description: Reload the projects from the database.

buttons.label: Inspect Stored Version
buttons.description: Load the stored artifacts, fitted parameter values, branches and version graph of the selected version into the detail tabs below. Greyed until a row is selected.

buttons.label: Guide
buttons.description: Walk through finding, inspecting, restoring and saving projects.

buttons.label: Help
buttons.description: Explain project versions, restoration, permissions and archives.

sections.label: Search
sections.description: Search stored project names, identifiers, owners and version notes. The list reloads when you press Enter or click away.
Empty the search field and show every project again.

buttons.label: Clear
buttons.description: Empty the search field and show every project again.

sections.label: Show public
sections.description: Include projects made readable to other authenticated users.

sections.label: Show ID
sections.description: Show or hide the ID column (the project or version identifier). Undecided, it shows when the list is wide enough.

sections.label: Show status
sections.description: Show or hide the Status column (the state of a version's last operation). Undecided, it shows when the list is wide enough.

The stored projects and, under the triangle of each, their versions. Select a row to restore, inspect, export or delete it; double-click restores; click a header to sort. The ID and Status columns show when the list is wide enough for all nine columns; tick or untick Show ID and Show status to decide yourself.
The fields of the selected project or version.

columns.title: Field
columns.description: The name of the stored field.

sections.description: The artifacts stored with the selected version. Press Inspect Stored Version to load them.
The fitted parameter values stored with the selected version. Press Inspect Stored Version to load them.
The branches of the selected project. Press Inspect Stored Version to load them.
The version graph of the selected project: each stored field of its nodes and edges.

columns.title: Path
columns.description: Where in the version graph the value sits.

sections.label: Project name
sections.description: Name a new project; a new version of an existing project keeps its project name.

sections.label: Visibility
sections.description: Private is visible to its owner; public is readable by any authenticated user.
Optional notes recorded with the new version.
Save the project, or close this dialog without saving.

buttons.label: Save version
buttons.description: Serialize the current session and save one new database version.

buttons.label: Cancel
buttons.description: Close this dialog without changing the database.

_columns.title: Project / Version
_columns.description: The project with its version count, or a version with its number and name.

_columns.title: ID
_columns.description: The project or version identifier. Shown when the list is wide enough; the Show ID / Show status boxes above the list decide otherwise.

_columns.title: Owner
_columns.description: The user who owns the project or version.

_columns.title: Status
_columns.description: The state of a version's last operation. Shown when the list is wide enough; the Show ID / Show status boxes above the list decide otherwise.

_columns.title: Visibility
_columns.description: Private (owner only) or public (readable by authenticated users).

_columns.title: Datasets
_columns.description: How many datasets the version holds.

_columns.title: Fits
_columns.description: How many fits the version holds.

_columns.title: Notes
_columns.description: The notes recorded with the version.
